scenario: [LDET.3.2.7] / [LGRA.2.9.6.5] (display plane) — routing auto-Float display through ds_fmt_float must NOT clobber an explicit per-site interpolation format spec. When the interp carries a non-empty NUM_SPEC (`{v:.2f}`), the display path applies the user's format, not the canonical formatter: 3.14159 renders "3.14" (2-place rounded) and the whole Float 42.0 renders "42.00" (spec forces two fractional digits, so the canonical bare "42.0" must NOT win). The empty-spec canonical path is pinned by the sibling LDET.3.2.7 fixture; this one pins the spec-correct override behaviour. The interpreted lowering translates the DS NUM_SPEC into a complete printf conversion (`.2f` -> `%.2f`) so the interpreted path matches the AOT path.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    v: Float mutable

rule show:
    Reading r
->
    log critical "{r.v:.2f}"
